name: Maida
title: Crofter
examine: Flour to the elbows and a hoe within reach. The verge is hers as far as the fence, and the fence has opinions.
lines: Town folk ask why we live out here. Out here, nobody asks.
The brigands took two cows in the spring. The Watch took three brigands in the summer. Sums even out.
Buy an egg or carry news. Either pays.
